title: ManualFlowTask
description: An optional, human-operated Google Flow motion-polish request. Never a blocking dependency for publishing a video (TECHNICAL-SPEC-EN.md section 6).

status.description: 'skipped' is always a valid terminal state — the video must already be publishable without this task.

blocking.description: Always false. A manual-flow-task must never gate publication.

instructions.description: Human-readable instructions per prompts/STAGE-PROMPTS.md's stage-manual-flow-note-v1: state it's optional, that a complete local render already exists, and what would benefit.

input_clip_path.description: The already-rendered local clip this task would polish.

output_clip_path.description: Set once a human completes the task and provides a Flow-polished replacement clip.

local_fallback_clip_path.description: The clip actually used if this task is never picked up. Should usually equal input_clip_path.
